title: Our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: A Name That Carries Warmth and Love in Our Home
summary:
Imagine your little one playing around you, their eyes following your movements, and their ears catching the tone of your voice more than the words themselves. Perhaps you mention the name of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in a casual conversation, or while reading a book, or even when you send blessings upon him. In these ordinary moments, your child receives a message far deeper than mere information; they receive a feeling of love and appreciation for this name, and a strong foundation for their future love for him is built in their heart.

At this early age (2-3 years), your child doesn't need the details of the Prophet's biography or historical events. Their young mind is still in the process of building basic concepts of the world around them. What they clearly perceive are the emotions associated with names and people. When they hear the Prophet's name ﷺ mentioned in their home with a gentle tone, full of respect and affection, accompanied by prayers and blessings, they connect this name with these positive feelings. This is the first building block upon which all the stories and great qualities of our noble Prophet will later be built.

Don't pressure yourself to provide a lot of complex information. It's enough to make mentioning the Prophet's name ﷺ a natural and warm part of your day. Say his name, send blessings upon him audibly, then add a simple and loving phrase like: "Our Prophet Muhammad loved children." These small, repeated moments are what plant the first seeds of love and reverence in your child's heart, preparing them to receive his fragrant biography with understanding and passion when they grow a little older.
try_this: Today: Every time you mention the name of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in front of your child, send blessings upon him audibly, then follow it with a short, warm phrase like: "Our Prophet Muhammad loved children."
